version_probe.pass: server.info returns a non-empty Moonraker version; record it in the QA evidence, not this fixture.
version_probe.blocker: Moonraker is absent, unreachable from the agent LAN, or server.info has no version.

probe.pass: Subscription accepts print_stats, extruder, heater_bed and virtual_sdcard and emits notify_status_update.
probe.blocker: Required printer objects or push telemetry are unavailable.

probe.pass: print_stats is listed; pause/resume/cancel/start probes are permitted by the physical-print safety check.
probe.blocker: print_stats is missing or the operator cannot safely perform a command probe.

probe.pass: A harmless QA G-code file uploads into the gcodes root.
probe.blocker: Upload endpoint is disabled, unauthorized, or storage is unavailable.

subscription.pass: Updates arrive through notify_status_update without polling.
subscription.blocker: Subscription or notify_status_update does not work.

config.source: Printer-local Klipper configuration: ~/printer_data/config/printer.cfg and included *.cfg files; agent reads locally only.

rollback.point: Operator-created backup of the complete stock printer_data/config directory before installing any pilot visual or agent configuration.
rollback.operator_action: Restore that backup using the printer's local recovery procedure; do not remotely overwrite firmware.

verification.pass: Restored printer returns server.info and the stock UI can start a local test print.
verification.blocker: No pre-change backup or local recovery path is available.

pilot_status.trust_limit: Есть только план и passport; обезличенного live-evidence на физическом FLSun V400 нет.
